# HQLA holding (`hqla-holding` v1)

A security held in the liquidity buffer: its HQLA level, haircut and liquidity value.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `HQLA` · **Identifiers:** `HQLA-…` in `holdingId`

Open one with `HQLA <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: hqla-holding
version: 1
description: "A security held in the liquidity buffer: its HQLA level, haircut and liquidity value."
match: { kind: hqla-holding, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · HQLA holding, id: $.holdingId }
strip:
  - { label: Security, bind: $.security }
  - { label: Level, bind: $.level }
  - { label: Market value, bind: $.marketValue, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Haircut, bind: $.haircut, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Liquidity value, bind: $.liquidityValue, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Encumbered, bind: $.encumbered }
panels:
  - id: details
    kind: kv
    title: Holding
    key: F2
    rows: $.details
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.bond, 'bond')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
